works.title: The Experience of God
works.subtitle: Orthodox Dogmatic Theology, Vol. 1: Revelation and Knowledge of the Triune God
works.author: Dumitru Stăniloae
works.blurb: The opening volume of Stăniloae's monumental dogmatics, treating divine revelation and the knowledge of the Holy Trinity. A landmark of twentieth-century Orthodox theology, rooted throughout in the Fathers and the experience of prayer.
